meta.title: Your learning ledger | Covate
meta.description: Review the learning sessions your Covate MCP has synced: each session's score, your running accuracy, and the topics you answer worst.

signIn.title: Your <brand>learning ledger</brand>
signIn.body: Sign in with GitHub — free, nothing to buy — and the sessions your Covate MCP syncs up land here: every quiz you took on your own code, your running accuracy, and the topics you answer worst.
signIn.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable on this deployment — its GitHub credentials or database are not configured, so no one can sign in right now (this is an outage, not a paywall; the ledger is free). The free open-source MCP works offline and is available now on <link>GitHub</link>.

errors.not_configured: Sign-in is not available right now — this deployment is missing its GitHub credentials. We are on it.
errors.bad_state: That sign-in link expired or was already used. Please try again.
errors.login_failed: GitHub could not complete the sign-in. Please try again.

topics.title: Concepts to revisit
topics.empty: No topic data yet — quiz yourself with the MCP and it'll show up here.

sessions.title: Recent learning sessions
sessions.empty: No sessions synced yet. From a project you have used Covate in, run COVATE_SYNC_URL=https://covate.org COVATE_SYNC_TOKEN={placeholder} python -m covate.platform_sync to push your local learning history here. Reveal your token in the Sync token section below.

syncToken.title: Sync token
syncToken.intro: The MCP sync client authenticates with this token. From a project you have used Covate in, run COVATE_SYNC_URL=https://covate.org COVATE_SYNC_TOKEN={placeholder} python -m covate.platform_sync It is a password: anything holding it can write sessions to your ledger.
syncToken.rotateConfirm: Rotating breaks any client still using the old token. Sure?
syncToken.copyError: Could not copy — select the token and copy it manually.

device.unreachable: Could not reach GitHub. Please try again.
device.expired: That code expired. Start again and it will only take a moment.
device.enterCode: Enter this code on <link>github.com/login/device</link>, then come back here — this page signs you in on its own.
